caption: Crosshair | N: uniform horizontal and vertical axes
LogCrosshair | M: small steps near the cursor, bigger steps farther away
ElementHints | Tab: control labels; + opens a group
ElementHints L2 | Linked badges preserve parent and child controls
UniformGrid | J then T: open a finer subgrid
UniformGrid | G: select a subgrid column
UniformGrid | G then Y: refine the target without clicking
UniformGrid | Escape: return to the previous level
